description: Stal je fiets op z’n Gronings is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Groningen. De grote aantallen los gestalde fietsen is aanleiding geweest tot het starten van het project stadfietsen. Het project bestaat uit drie fases. De eerste fase is het uitbreiden van fietsenklemmen in de binnenstad op locaties waar momenteel ruimte voor is. Coverage: Gemeente Groningen. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Groningen. Its tags are Fietsenstallingen, enquete, fietsen, intervieuws. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
